categories.name: Promotional
categories.description: Sales, marketing offers, discount codes, coupons, brand promotions.

categories.name: SocialMedia
categories.description: Notifications from Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit.

categories.name: SpamOrPhishing
categories.description: Unsolicited bulk mail, scams, obvious phishing attempts.

categories.name: LowValueNotification
categories.description: Low-value automated notices: marketing app pings, throwaway product updates, blog 'we miss you' nudges.

categories.name: Newsletter
categories.description: Subscribed newsletters, blog digests, substack-style writing the user opted into.

categories.name: AccountUpdate
categories.description: Service account changes: settings updated, new device sign-in, plan changed, profile edits.

categories.name: EventReminder
categories.description: Event reminders, RSVPs, calendar invites, webinar prompts. May be useful before event, deletable after.

categories.name: Banking
categories.description: Bank statements, balance alerts, transfer confirmations, credit card account communications.

categories.name: Bills
categories.description: Utility bills, rent invoices, subscription renewals with money due, payment reminders.

categories.name: Security
categories.description: Two-factor codes, security alerts, suspicious sign-in warnings, password resets.

categories.name: Shipping
categories.description: Shipping notifications, tracking updates, delivery confirmations.

categories.name: Receipt
categories.description: Order confirmations, purchase receipts, invoices for completed transactions.

categories.name: School
categories.description: School/university communications: classes, grades, registrar, faculty correspondence.

categories.name: Job
categories.description: Recruiter outreach, interview scheduling, job application status, offer letters.

categories.name: Work
categories.description: Work and business correspondence: meetings, projects, internal company communications.

categories.name: Personal
categories.description: Real human-to-human correspondence from friends, family, non-business contacts.

categories.name: MedicalInsuranceLegal
categories.description: Medical, insurance, legal correspondence including appointments, claims, contracts, lawyer/notary mail.

categories.name: Unknown
categories.description: Doesn't clearly fit any of the categories above; needs manual review.
